topics.title: Importance of chemistry and nature of matter

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how chemistry contributes to health, industry and the environment.
Explain the solid, liquid and gaseous states in terms of particle arrangement and motion.
Classify matter into mixtures, elements and compounds.

topics.title: Properties of matter and their measurement

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the SI base units and the quantities they measure.
Distinguish mass from weight and convert between units of volume.
Calculate density and convert temperatures between the Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin scales.
Apply the rules of significant figures and scientific notation to measured quantities and results.
Distinguish precision from accuracy using sets of measurements.
Convert units using the unit factor method.
State the law of conservation of mass and its significance.
Apply the laws of definite and multiple proportions to mass data.
Apply Gay Lussac's law of gaseous volumes and Avogadro's law.

topics.title: Dalton's atomic theory and atomic and molecular masses

concepts.learning_objective: State the postulates of Dalton's atomic theory.
Define the atomic mass unit and calculate average atomic mass from isotopic data.
Calculate molecular mass and explain when formula mass is used.

topics.title: Mole concept, percentage composition and empirical formula

concepts.learning_objective: Relate mass, moles and number of particles using molar mass and the Avogadro constant.
Calculate the mass per cent of an element in a compound.
Derive empirical and molecular formulas from percentage composition and molar mass.

topics.title: Stoichiometry, limiting reagent and reactions in solutions

concepts.learning_objective: Use a balanced equation to calculate masses of reactants and products.
Identify the limiting reagent and the amount of product it allows.
Express and calculate concentration as molarity and related terms.
